Google Maps

This build shows Google Maps. Basemap requests go to Google and reveal the approximate area being viewed. The Maps SDK also sends Google device details (OS version and model), your IP address, a pseudonymous SDK identifier, crash reports and map-interaction events such as panning and zooming; Google handles them under the Google Privacy Policy (policies.google.com/privacy). TrailVeil never sends your recorded route to Google. Map loads are attributed to the TrailVeil developer\'s Google Cloud project and key, not to you; they are currently free and unlimited for mobile apps, and if that ever changed TrailVeil would have to change how the map is provided rather than charge you.

Google Maps content is subject to the Google Maps Additional Terms of Service (maps.google.com/help/terms_maps). The Google logo on the map is Google\'s attribution and stays visible. TrailVeil uses no Google account, no Places lookups, no map styling ID and no advertising SDK.
